test_gil_deadlock_single_thread: test that no GIL deadlock occurs when calling C++ callbacks from a single Python thread
test_gil_deadlock_parallel_threads: test that no GIL deadlock occurs when calling C++ callbacks from multiple parallel Python threads
test_gil_deadlock_sequential_threads: test that no GIL deadlock occurs when calling C++ callbacks from multiple sequential Python threads
test_gil_deadlock_multiprocess: test that no GIL deadlock occurs when calling C++ callbacks from a separate Python process
test_cross_module_gil_acquire: test that the GIL can be acquired by another module from a GIL-released state without segfault
